payload.title: feat/reading-hold 33f18e0: open reading holds decision and next Hypothesis
payload.body: Commit 33f18e038798bd6f208b4b5472b39faa7e92a56c on feat/reading-hold. Every open reading on Q holds Q's select, choose, stale and reaffirm (turn waits on each). NextHold holds rivals and add hyp while a reach is not empty or no unreferred open limit from a Result on Q exists, with a premise exception; AdmitRetire holds supersede and abandon of a Hypothesis in a reach. Reach adds an inconclusive Hypothesis its Result judged inconclusive, which owes no undecided.

why: OWED owes rivals on Q-F0E223; first build commit for G-5W1F5S.
Tie h-hold-1 to its commit before the gate.

payload.title: Gate and review of h-hold-1 (33f18e0)
payload.body:
Gate of h-hold-1, commit 33f18e0, aims G-5W1F5S#1-#6. Rubric, read from logs in .tree/evidence/<E>/:
(1) New tests (internal/cli/reading_hold_test.go, reach_test.go) on base afe2c1f, run before this add: red TestReadingOnDeadRivalHoldsNextHypothesis, TestOpenReadingWithNoReachHoldsSelect (#1,#6), ...HoldsChoice, TestOpenReadingOnNoTargetResultHoldsSelect, TestOpenReadingHoldsStaleAndReaffirm (#1), TestReadingOnInconclusiveOwesNoUndecided (#2), TestOpenReadingHoldsNextHypothesis, TestReadingOnInconclusiveHoldsNextHypothesis, TestReadingWithNoReachHoldsNextHypothesis (#3); green on base TestPremiseReleasesNextHypothesis (#3 exception), TestReadingWithNoReachReleasedByLimit (#4), TestAnsweredReadingsHoldNothing (#5). Each must be green on the commit.
(2) Removal checks, each a patch on a checkout of the commit that must apply whole (else a failed removal); the named test must then fail: R1 drop the add-hyp admit in write.go -> TestOpenReadingHoldsNextHypothesis; R2 drop the supersede admit -> same; R3 drop the abandon case in admitOnNode -> TestReadingOnInconclusiveHoldsNextHypothesis; R4 drop the reaffirm case -> TestOpenReadingHoldsStaleAndReaffirm; R5 restore the reach filter in openReadings -> TestOpenReadingWithNoReachHoldsSelect; R6 drop !p.movedBy(h) -> TestReadingOnInconclusiveOwesNoUndecided; R7 drop the premise exception in AdmitAddHyp -> TestPremiseReleasesNextHypothesis.
(3) go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 pass on the commit.
(4) Review: a fresh subagent reviews git show 33f18e038798bd6f208b4b5472b39faa7e92a56c against the Goal lines and body, and returns each finding as a test with its output on the commit, labelled with its line or none. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the commit contradicts h-hold-1.
supports: (1)-(4) hold. contradicts: a (1) test red on the commit, a removal that applies and leaves its test green, a gate failure, or a red review test of a line. inconclusive: only red findings whose line is in doubt.

why: The repository keeps no gate recipe; the body states the gate as its rubric.

payload.observation: Gate of 33f18e0: go vet and go test ./... pass; the 13 new tests are green on the commit, 9 red and 4 green on base afe2c1f as the rubric states; all 7 removal checks apply whole and their tests fail. Review: one finding, run red on the commit: hyp link NEW supersedes H writes the supersedes edge and exits 0 while an open reading can move H. Its line is in doubt (reading r1), and it is the only failure, so h-hold-1 is inconclusive.
readings: G-5W1F5S#3: "hyp supersede --old H" has two meanings. Meaning 1: only the hyp supersede command must exit 1. Meaning 2: each command that writes a supersedes edge to H must exit 1, so hyp link NEW supersedes H must exit 1 too. Example: H can move; hyp link H2 supersedes H exits 0 and H is superseded. TestLinkSupersedesHeldLikeSupersede tests meaning 2; h-hold-1 fails it. This run gives inconclusive. Question: must line 3 hold every command that writes the same supersedes edge, or only hyp supersede?

why: Gate and review of h-hold-1 ran; the only red finding is a case whose line coverage is in doubt.
